dedupe_keys.name: housing units saudi households by type of housing unit and source of electricity

description: Housing Units ( Saudi Households ) by Type of Housing Unit and Source of Electricity is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). Explore housing units in Saudi households categorized by type of housing unit and source of electricity in this dataset. Analyze semi-annual and annual data on various housing types including traditional houses, apartments, villas, and more, with details on electricity sources such as public network, private network, and private generator. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Economy, Electricity, Buildings. Its keywords are Housing, Residential, Housing data. The portal shows 2026-05-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
